long_biography.plain_text:
Viktor Rashnikov began at Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works as a mechanic in the equipment-repair shop. He combined mill work with metal-forming studies before moving through production, supply and technical posts. Appointments as chief engineer and general director gave him operating command across the steelworks.

Control now sits through Altair, the holding company that directly controls the steelmaker and identifies Rashnikov as its beneficiary. Under his strategic direction, MMK's modernization programme included the plate mill 5000, the cold-rolling mill 2000 and other extensive upgrades across existing production lines. The company also pursued digital transformation across quality control and customer operations.
